Agarican, Hoplite CR 1

XP 400
N Small plant (fungus)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +0, Will +0
Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +3 (1d6+1 plus poison)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 12, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 4
Base Atk +1; CMB +2, CMD 12 (16 vs. trip)
Feats Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+12 to jump), Perception +5
Languages Agaric

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Luminescent Lamella (Ex)

The underside of a hoplite constantly glows with a soft blue light, equivalent to a candle. This is suppressed whenever a hoplite is laying on the ground or otherwise concealing its underbelly.

Poison (Ex)

Slam—injury; save Fort DC 13; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Str; cure 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.

Powerful Leap (Ex)

A hoplite has a powerful set of rear legs, giving it a +8 bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.

ABOUT

Environment temperate forests or swamps
Organization solitary, pair, or ring (3-20)
Treasure none

Hoplites appear as squat, slightly conical mushrooms with four stocky legs, looking slightly reminiscent of a fungal tortoise. It moves much like a frog, in hopping bursts, and it has caught more than one traveler off-guard who expected it to move slowly. Despite not having a discernible head, anyone who has gotten familiar with one won’t have a problem telling which way it’s facing.

Acting primarily as guard dogs in agarician settlements, hoplites are common wherever more intelligent agaricians can be found.
